claim: With the spinning disk in, the path is confocal. With the disk out, the same hardware serves both widefield fluorescence and brightfield. Disk-out is therefore not a configuration of its own but a required selector value on configurations that already exist, and one selector position serves two different configurations.
validity_conditions: This instrument as configured on 2026-09-17, operator read at the instrument. The consequence worth carrying: the position labelled bright field is also the widefield-fluorescence position, so the configuration id cannot be recovered from this selector's label, and a read-back that confirms the label confirms nothing about which configuration is loaded. Falsified by a mechanical change to the disk carrier.
